name: Klara Brunner
bio:
Klara's journey into motorsport PR began somewhat unconventionally, starting with a degree in journalism and a passion for motorsports ignited by her father, a former rally driver. She honed her skills at smaller racing outfits, quickly establishing a reputation for crafting compelling narratives and managing media relations with a sharp eye for detail. Her ascent continued with a stint at a Formula 3 team before landing at Blau Motorsport.

At Blau, Klara is responsible for shaping the team's public image and ensuring a consistent message across all platforms. She is known for her meticulous approach, leaving no stone unturned when it comes to crafting press releases, managing interviews, and coordinating events. Klara is particularly adept at crisis communication, a skill she developed through years of experience navigating the often turbulent world of motorsport. Her ability to think strategically and see the big picture makes her an invaluable asset to the team, even if her demanding nature can occasionally ruffle feathers. 

Klara distinguishes herself with her relentless pursuit of perfection and her uncanny ability to anticipate potential PR pitfalls. She is a firm believer in transparency and honesty, and she insists on maintaining open communication with the media, fostering trust and credibility for Blau Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave and a side part
physical.description: Klara is a woman of medium height with a poised and professional demeanor.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized binder filled with press clippings and team information.
Insists on approving every social media post before it goes live.
Starts every meeting with a detailed agenda and sticks to it rigorously.
